Neuf piles de gemmes, reliques et sorts: Nine piles of gems, relics and spells drawn from your 98 cards. Pick the split and the market type before each fight.
Les meilleures cartes à chaque poste : é: The best card for every role: fast economy, deck thinning, opening spells and finishers.

Prends la table en photo (marché, et si: Take a photo of the table (market, and if possible the nemesis and mage boards). I recognise the cards and fill in the form; you check before saving.
Outil non officiel. Noms et coûts relevé: Unofficial tool. Card names, costs and effects are summarised from the French edition: when in doubt, the card is right. Power ratings and nemesis and mage profiles are a personal assessment. Expedition mode follows a summary of The New Age rules.
Plusieurs cartes produisent ou dépensent: Several cards produce or spend charges. Look for ways to trigger a mage's ability far more often than usual.
Certaines cartes se renforcent quand ta: Some cards get stronger when your discard pile holds six or seven cards. Watch for the moment it becomes your deck again.
Ce marché détruit des cartes à tour de b: This market destroys cards left and right. A ten-card deck with no Crystals left cycles very fast.
Tout pousse à ouvrir tes brèches tôt et: Everything pushes you to open your breaches early and keep several spells prepped at once.
Des sorts lancés deux fois, relancés ou: Spells cast twice, recast or boosted by a bonus. The same damage bonus can apply to every hit.
Les meilleures cartes ici agissent sur u: The best cards here affect an ally or want the same card on two mages. Split your purchases.
Des cartes récompensent le fait de gagne: Some cards reward gaining lots of cards, or emptying a supply pile.
Silence, petits dégâts répétés et bonus: Silence, small repeated damage and bonuses when a minion falls: save these cards for them rather than the nemesis.
Des soins, des cartes à sacrifier pour G: Healing, cards to sacrifice for Gravehold and effects that trigger when your life is at its lowest.
Pour une fois, tes Cristaux et tes Étinc: For once, your starting Crystals and Sparks are worth their weight in gold. Think before destroying them.
Plusieurs cartes lisent ou manipulent le: Several cards read or manipulate the turn order deck. Count the cards already drawn.
